acceptance_criteria.description: Required grid fields reject non-scalars, booleans, whitespace-only strings, and non-finite numbers while frozen identity checks remain unchanged
Work-package paths reject package-directory and component symlinks including in-root aliases and outside-root escapes
Receipts reject credential-bearing URI userinfo for any scheme while ordinary relative locators pass
BMP schemas, runner semantics, registries, results, claims, and NatureBench source remain unchanged
Focused tests, Ruff, compile, skill validation, collaboration validation, lab doctor, and diff checks pass

objective: Fail closed on malformed required grid evidence, symlinked work-package aliases, and credential-bearing URI userinfo without changing benchmark or runtime semantics.
title: Harden repository skill validators
